analysis: The code snippet defines a method `getSchemaForField(int i)` that calls `subFields.get(i)`. The `get` method from Java's List interface throws an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` if the index is out of range (i < 0 or i >= list size). The snippet does not perform any bounds check on `i` before the call. After the call, it checks if the returned value is null and throws a `RuntimeException` if so, but this does not prevent the `IndexOutOfBoundsException`. Therefore, the exception condition is not avoided in the calling context.
remark: The IndexOutOfBoundsException will be thrown if the input parameter `i` is negative or greater than or equal to the size of the `subFields` list, because the `get` method is called without any prior validation of the index.
